dex_aggregator.name: DEX Aggregator
dex_aggregator.description: DEX aggregator integrating cross-contract swaps with footprint restoration for optimal routing
dex_aggregator.architecture:
graph LR
    A[User Swap Request] -->|parse routes| B[DEX Aggregator]
    B -->|detect keys| C[Footprint Analyzer]
    C -->|restore keys| D[Contract Executor]
    D -->|execute swap| E[Token Transfer]
    E -->|return result| F[User]
lessonsLearned: Pre-compute common swap routes to reduce detection time
Cache restored footprints for frequently used DEX pairs
Batch multiple swaps in single transaction to amortize restoration cost
Monitor gas usage - restoration adds ~150k units per operation
Implement fallback for routes with incomplete footprints

lending_protocol.name: Lending Protocol
lending_protocol.description: Lending protocol with liquidation calls leveraging cross-contract key restoration
lending_protocol.architecture:
graph LR
    A[Monitor Positions] -->|detect liquidation| B[Liquidator]
    B -->|get affected keys| C[Position Analyzer]
    C -->|restore keys| D[Liquidation Engine]
    D -->|execute liquidation| E[Collateral Transfer]
    E -->|claim reward| F[Liquidator Account]
lessonsLearned: Prioritize liquidations with higher health factor gaps
Use parallel detection for multiple positions to save time
Store health factor history to predict liquidation events
Implement MEV protection by timing liquidations carefully
Account for gas price volatility when calculating liquidation profitability

nft_marketplace.name: NFT Marketplace
nft_marketplace.description: NFT marketplace with batch operations using cross-contract key restoration
nft_marketplace.architecture:
graph LR
    A[Batch List Request] -->|parse NFTs| B[Marketplace]
    B -->|detect keys| C[Key Detector]
    C -->|restore all| D[Batch Processor]
    D -->|list NFTs| E[Marketplace Contract]
    E -->|emit events| F[Index/Frontend]
lessonsLearned: Batch operations show highest improvement (>75% faster)
Limit batch size to 50-100 items for optimal throughput
Use streaming for large NFT collections (>1000 items)
Implement progress tracking for UI responsiveness
Cache collection-level footprints for repeated operations

bridge_contract.name: Bridge Contract
bridge_contract.description: Bridge contract with multiple validators using key restoration for consensus
bridge_contract.architecture:
graph LR
    A[Cross-chain Message] -->|validate| B[Validator Set]
    B -->|detect keys| C[Signature Verifier]
    C -->|restore keys| D[Consensus Engine]
    D -->|collect sigs| E[Threshold Checker]
    E -->|mint/burn| F[Bridge Token]
lessonsLearned: Validator set management is critical - cache and validate regularly
Use threshold scheme (N of M) to reduce verification burden
Implement time windows for signature collection
Monitor validator responsiveness - exclude slow validators if needed
Test bridge security with contract verification tools

yield_aggregator.name: Yield Aggregator
yield_aggregator.description: Yield aggregator with strategy composition using cross-contract restoration
yield_aggregator.architecture:
graph LR
    A[User Deposit] -->|allocate| B[Strategy Composer]
    B -->|detect keys| C[Contract Analyzer]
    C -->|restore keys| D[Execution Engine]
    D -->|execute strategies| E[DeFi Protocols]
    E -->|accrue yield| F[User Account]
lessonsLearned: Rebalancing operations benefit most from batching (>75% faster)
Implement automated rebalancing on schedule or price thresholds
Use dust collection strategy for small remaining balances
Monitor strategy performance and adjust allocations dynamically
Set maximum slippage tolerance to protect against sandwich attacks
